CREATE TABLE crosswalk_<domain> (
    real_norm     VARCHAR NOT NULL,   -- normalized real value; the assignment key
    fake          VARCHAR NOT NULL,   -- assigned fake value
    assigned_seq  BIGINT  NOT NULL,   -- monotonic append order within the domain (audit + tie-break)
    -- domain-specific columns follow, e.g. for first_name:
    --   gender     VARCHAR            -- 'ז' | 'נ' | NULL  (the bucket the fake was drawn from)
    PRIMARY KEY (real_norm),          -- one fake per real  ⇒ deterministic
    UNIQUE (fake)                     -- injective          ⇒ unambiguous reverse
);

SELECT
            max(ts) AS manifest_watermark,
            owner,
            lower(owner || '_' || table_name) AS table_name,
            max(n_rows) AS row_count
        FROM _manifest
        WHERE lower(owner || '_' || table_name) IN ('aviv_bo_cs_cash_sales', 'aviv_bo_cs_products', 'mlai_products', 'mlai_family', 'mlai_product_price', 'mlai_o2product_cost', 'mlai_order_header', 'mlai_order_lines', 'account_invoices_tax', 'account_invoice_products', 'account_invoice_products_cost', 'account_supplier_invoices')
        GROUP BY owner, table_name
        ORDER BY table_name

SELECT
            table_name,
            ordinal_position,
            column_name,
            data_type,
            is_nullable
        FROM information_schema.columns
        WHERE table_name IN ('aviv_bo_cs_cash_sales', 'aviv_bo_cs_products', 'mlai_products', 'mlai_family', 'mlai_product_price', 'mlai_o2product_cost', 'mlai_order_header', 'mlai_order_lines', 'account_invoices_tax', 'account_invoice_products', 'account_invoice_products_cost', 'account_supplier_invoices')
        ORDER BY table_name, ordinal_position

SELECT
            lower(owner || '_' || table_name) AS table_name,
            n_rows AS row_count
        FROM _manifest
        WHERE regexp_matches(lower(table_name), '(product|family|catalog)')
          AND NOT regexp_matches(
              lower(table_name),
              '(_history|_h|_log|_old|_tmp|_temp|_bak|_gtmp[0-9]*)$|[0-9]{6}$|_[0-9]{4,}$'
          )
        ORDER BY row_count DESC, table_name

WITH bounds AS (
    SELECT
        max(SA_DATE)::DATE AS data_max_date,
        date_trunc('month', max(SA_DATE))::DATE AS open_month_start
    FROM aviv_bo_cs_cash_sales
    WHERE SA_COMPID = 1
),
periods AS (
    SELECT
        data_max_date,
        open_month_start,
        (open_month_start - INTERVAL 1 MONTH)::DATE AS latest_closed_start,
        open_month_start AS latest_closed_end,
        (open_month_start - INTERVAL 12 MONTH)::DATE AS trailing_12_start
    FROM bounds
)

        SELECT
            (SELECT max(ts) FROM _manifest) AS manifest_max_timestamp,
            (SELECT min(SA_DATE)::DATE FROM aviv_bo_cs_cash_sales WHERE SA_COMPID = 1) AS sales_min_date,
            data_max_date,
            latest_closed_start,
            latest_closed_end,
            trailing_12_start
        FROM periods

WITH bounds AS (
    SELECT
        max(SA_DATE)::DATE AS data_max_date,
        date_trunc('month', max(SA_DATE))::DATE AS open_month_start
    FROM aviv_bo_cs_cash_sales
    WHERE SA_COMPID = 1
),
periods AS (
    SELECT
        data_max_date,
        open_month_start,
        (open_month_start - INTERVAL 1 MONTH)::DATE AS latest_closed_start,
        open_month_start AS latest_closed_end,
        (open_month_start - INTERVAL 12 MONTH)::DATE AS trailing_12_start
    FROM bounds
)

        SELECT
            date_trunc('month', sales.SA_DATE)::DATE AS sales_month,
            count(*) AS line_count,
            count(DISTINCT sales.SA_PRODUCT_ID) AS distinct_product_ids,
            round(sum(sales.SA_TOTAL), 2) AS realized_total_including_vat,
            max(sales.SA_INSERT_DATE)::DATE AS latest_insert_date
        FROM aviv_bo_cs_cash_sales AS sales
        CROSS JOIN periods
        WHERE sales.SA_COMPID = 1
          AND sales.SA_DATE >= periods.trailing_12_start - INTERVAL 2 MONTH
          AND sales.SA_DATE < periods.data_max_date + INTERVAL 1 DAY
        GROUP BY sales_month
        ORDER BY sales_month

WITH product_keys AS (
            SELECT
                COMPID,
                PRODUCT_ID,
                count(*) AS rows_per_key,
                count(DISTINCT FAMILY) AS family_variants,
                count(DISTINCT COST_PRICE) AS cost_variants
            FROM mlai_products
            GROUP BY COMPID, PRODUCT_ID
        ),
        pos_product_keys AS (
            SELECT
                WIN_COMPID AS COMPID,
                WIN_PRODUCT_ID AS PRODUCT_ID,
                count(*) AS rows_per_key,
                count(DISTINCT WIN_COST_PRICE) AS cost_variants
            FROM aviv_bo_cs_products
            GROUP BY WIN_COMPID, WIN_PRODUCT_ID
        )
        SELECT
            'mlai_products' AS source,
            COMPID,
            sum(rows_per_key) AS row_count,
            count(*) AS distinct_product_ids,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE rows_per_key > 1) AS duplicate_id_groups,
            coalesce(sum(rows_per_key - 1) FILTER (WHERE rows_per_key > 1), 0) AS duplicate_extra_rows,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE family_variants > 1) AS conflicting_family_groups,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE cost_variants > 1) AS conflicting_cost_groups
        FROM product_keys
        GROUP BY COMPID
        UNION ALL
        SELECT
            'aviv_bo_cs_products' AS source,
            COMPID,
            sum(rows_per_key) AS row_count,
            count(*) AS distinct_product_ids,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE rows_per_key > 1) AS duplicate_id_groups,
            coalesce(sum(rows_per_key - 1) FILTER (WHERE rows_per_key > 1), 0) AS duplicate_extra_rows,
            NULL AS conflicting_family_groups,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE cost_variants > 1) AS conflicting_cost_groups
        FROM pos_product_keys
        GROUP BY COMPID
        ORDER BY source, COMPID

WITH bounds AS (
    SELECT
        max(SA_DATE)::DATE AS data_max_date,
        date_trunc('month', max(SA_DATE))::DATE AS open_month_start
    FROM aviv_bo_cs_cash_sales
    WHERE SA_COMPID = 1
),
periods AS (
    SELECT
        data_max_date,
        open_month_start,
        (open_month_start - INTERVAL 1 MONTH)::DATE AS latest_closed_start,
        open_month_start AS latest_closed_end,
        (open_month_start - INTERVAL 12 MONTH)::DATE AS trailing_12_start
    FROM bounds
)

        , labeled_sales AS (
            SELECT 'latest_closed_month' AS period, sales.*
            FROM aviv_bo_cs_cash_sales AS sales
            CROSS JOIN periods
            WHERE sales.SA_COMPID = 1
              AND sales.SA_DATE >= periods.latest_closed_start
              AND sales.SA_DATE < periods.latest_closed_end
            UNION ALL
            SELECT 'trailing_12_closed_months' AS period, sales.*
            FROM aviv_bo_cs_cash_sales AS sales
            CROSS JOIN periods
            WHERE sales.SA_COMPID = 1
              AND sales.SA_DATE >= periods.trailing_12_start
              AND sales.SA_DATE < periods.latest_closed_end
        )
        SELECT
            period,
            count(*) AS line_count,
            count(DISTINCT SA_PRODUCT_ID) AS distinct_product_ids,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE SA_PRODUCT_ID IS NULL OR trim(SA_PRODUCT_ID) = '') AS missing_product_id_lines,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE SA_QTY IS NULL) AS missing_quantity_lines,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE SA_TOTAL IS NULL) AS missing_total_lines,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE SA_VAT_SUM IS NULL) AS missing_vat_lines,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE SA_COST_PRICE IS NULL) AS missing_book_cost_lines,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE SA_TOTAL > 0) AS positive_total_lines,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE SA_TOTAL < 0) AS negative_total_lines,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE SA_TOTAL = 0) AS zero_total_lines,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE SA_COST_PRICE = 0) AS zero_book_cost_lines,
            round(sum(SA_TOTAL), 2) AS realized_total_including_vat,
            round(sum(SA_TOTAL - coalesce(SA_VAT_SUM, 0)), 2) AS candidate_net_revenue,
            round(sum(SA_QTY * SA_COST_PRICE), 2) AS candidate_signed_book_cogs
        FROM labeled_sales
        GROUP BY period
        ORDER BY period

WITH bounds AS (
    SELECT
        max(SA_DATE)::DATE AS data_max_date,
        date_trunc('month', max(SA_DATE))::DATE AS open_month_start
    FROM aviv_bo_cs_cash_sales
    WHERE SA_COMPID = 1
),
periods AS (
    SELECT
        data_max_date,
        open_month_start,
        (open_month_start - INTERVAL 1 MONTH)::DATE AS latest_closed_start,
        open_month_start AS latest_closed_end,
        (open_month_start - INTERVAL 12 MONTH)::DATE AS trailing_12_start
    FROM bounds
)

        SELECT
            sign(sales.SA_TOTAL) AS total_sign,
            sign(sales.SA_QTY) AS quantity_sign,
            count(*) AS line_count,
            round(sum(sales.SA_TOTAL), 2) AS realized_total_including_vat,
            round(sum(sales.SA_QTY * sales.SA_COST_PRICE), 2) AS candidate_signed_book_cogs,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE sales.SA_COST_PRICE < 0) AS negative_book_cost_field_lines,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE sales.SA_COST_PRICE = 0) AS zero_book_cost_field_lines
        FROM aviv_bo_cs_cash_sales AS sales
        CROSS JOIN periods
        WHERE sales.SA_COMPID = 1
          AND sales.SA_DATE >= periods.trailing_12_start
          AND sales.SA_DATE < periods.latest_closed_end
        GROUP BY total_sign, quantity_sign
        ORDER BY total_sign, quantity_sign

WITH bounds AS (
    SELECT
        max(SA_DATE)::DATE AS data_max_date,
        date_trunc('month', max(SA_DATE))::DATE AS open_month_start
    FROM aviv_bo_cs_cash_sales
    WHERE SA_COMPID = 1
),
periods AS (
    SELECT
        data_max_date,
        open_month_start,
        (open_month_start - INTERVAL 1 MONTH)::DATE AS latest_closed_start,
        open_month_start AS latest_closed_end,
        (open_month_start - INTERVAL 12 MONTH)::DATE AS trailing_12_start
    FROM bounds
)

        , negative_lines AS (
            SELECT sales.*
            FROM aviv_bo_cs_cash_sales AS sales
            CROSS JOIN periods
            WHERE sales.SA_COMPID = 1
              AND sales.SA_DATE >= periods.trailing_12_start
              AND sales.SA_DATE < periods.latest_closed_end
              AND sales.SA_TOTAL < 0
        )
        SELECT
            count(*) AS negative_total_lines,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE SA_QTY < 0) AS negative_quantity_lines,
            count(*) FILTER (
                WHERE SA_FROM_WHS IS NOT NULL
                  AND SA_FROM_CASH_NO IS NOT NULL
                  AND SA_FROM_DATE IS NOT NULL
                  AND SA_FROM_SALE_NO IS NOT NULL
            ) AS complete_origin_reference_lines,
            count(*) FILTER (
                WHERE EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM aviv_bo_cs_cash_sales AS original
                    WHERE original.SA_COMPID = negative_lines.SA_COMPID
                      AND original.SA_WHS = negative_lines.SA_FROM_WHS
                      AND original.SA_CASH_NO = negative_lines.SA_FROM_CASH_NO
                      AND original.SA_DATE::DATE = negative_lines.SA_FROM_DATE::DATE
                      AND original.SA_SALE_NO = negative_lines.SA_FROM_SALE_NO
                )
            ) AS origin_receipt_found_lines,
            round(sum(SA_TOTAL), 2) AS negative_realized_total
        FROM negative_lines

WITH bounds AS (
    SELECT
        max(SA_DATE)::DATE AS data_max_date,
        date_trunc('month', max(SA_DATE))::DATE AS open_month_start
    FROM aviv_bo_cs_cash_sales
    WHERE SA_COMPID = 1
),
periods AS (
    SELECT
        data_max_date,
        open_month_start,
        (open_month_start - INTERVAL 1 MONTH)::DATE AS latest_closed_start,
        open_month_start AS latest_closed_end,
        (open_month_start - INTERVAL 12 MONTH)::DATE AS trailing_12_start
    FROM bounds
)

        , scoped_sales AS (
            SELECT sales.*
            FROM aviv_bo_cs_cash_sales AS sales
            CROSS JOIN periods
            WHERE sales.SA_COMPID = 1
              AND sales.SA_DATE >= periods.trailing_12_start
              AND sales.SA_DATE < periods.latest_closed_end
        ),
        zero_lines AS (
            SELECT *
            FROM scoped_sales
            WHERE SA_TOTAL = 0
        )
        SELECT
            count(*) AS zero_total_lines,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE SA_QTY <> 0) AS nonzero_quantity_lines,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE SA_PRICE = 0) AS zero_list_price_lines,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE SA_PRICE <> 0) AS nonzero_list_price_lines,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE SA_COST_PRICE > 0) AS positive_book_cost_lines,
            count(*) FILTER (
                WHERE EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM scoped_sales AS paid
                    WHERE paid.SA_WHS = zero_lines.SA_WHS
                      AND paid.SA_CASH_NO = zero_lines.SA_CASH_NO
                      AND paid.SA_DATE = zero_lines.SA_DATE
                      AND paid.SA_SALE_NO = zero_lines.SA_SALE_NO
                      AND paid.SA_TOTAL > 0
                )
            ) AS lines_on_receipts_with_positive_line,
            count(DISTINCT (SA_WHS, SA_CASH_NO, SA_DATE, SA_SALE_NO)) AS zero_line_receipts
        FROM zero_lines

WITH bounds AS (
    SELECT
        max(SA_DATE)::DATE AS data_max_date,
        date_trunc('month', max(SA_DATE))::DATE AS open_month_start
    FROM aviv_bo_cs_cash_sales
    WHERE SA_COMPID = 1
),
periods AS (
    SELECT
        data_max_date,
        open_month_start,
        (open_month_start - INTERVAL 1 MONTH)::DATE AS latest_closed_start,
        open_month_start AS latest_closed_end,
        (open_month_start - INTERVAL 12 MONTH)::DATE AS trailing_12_start
    FROM bounds
)

        , product_master AS (
            SELECT
                PRODUCT_ID,
                min(FAMILY) AS FAMILY,
                min(SERVICE) AS SERVICE,
                min(COST_PRICE) AS COST_PRICE,
                count(*) AS master_rows,
                count(DISTINCT FAMILY) AS family_variants
            FROM mlai_products
            WHERE COMPID = 1
            GROUP BY PRODUCT_ID
        ),
        family_master AS (
            SELECT FAMILY
            FROM mlai_family
            WHERE COMPID = 1
            GROUP BY FAMILY
        ),
        scoped_sales AS (
            SELECT sales.*
            FROM aviv_bo_cs_cash_sales AS sales
            CROSS JOIN periods
            WHERE sales.SA_COMPID = 1
              AND sales.SA_DATE >= periods.trailing_12_start
              AND sales.SA_DATE < periods.latest_closed_end
        )
        SELECT
            count(*) AS sales_lines,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE product_master.PRODUCT_ID IS NOT NULL) AS product_master_matched_lines,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE product_master.PRODUCT_ID IS NULL) AS product_master_unmatched_lines,
            count(DISTINCT scoped_sales.SA_PRODUCT_ID) AS sold_product_ids,
            count(DISTINCT scoped_sales.SA_PRODUCT_ID) FILTER (WHERE product_master.PRODUCT_ID IS NULL) AS unmatched_sold_product_ids,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE product_master.FAMILY IS NULL) AS missing_family_lines,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE family_master.FAMILY IS NULL) AS family_master_unmatched_lines,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE product_master.family_variants > 1) AS conflicting_family_lines,
            round(sum(abs(scoped_sales.SA_TOTAL)), 2) AS absolute_realized_total,
            round(sum(abs(scoped_sales.SA_TOTAL)) FILTER (WHERE product_master.PRODUCT_ID IS NULL), 2) AS unmatched_absolute_total
        FROM scoped_sales
        LEFT JOIN product_master
          ON product_master.PRODUCT_ID = scoped_sales.SA_PRODUCT_ID
        LEFT JOIN family_master
          ON family_master.FAMILY = product_master.FAMILY

WITH bounds AS (
    SELECT
        max(SA_DATE)::DATE AS data_max_date,
        date_trunc('month', max(SA_DATE))::DATE AS open_month_start
    FROM aviv_bo_cs_cash_sales
    WHERE SA_COMPID = 1
),
periods AS (
    SELECT
        data_max_date,
        open_month_start,
        (open_month_start - INTERVAL 1 MONTH)::DATE AS latest_closed_start,
        open_month_start AS latest_closed_end,
        (open_month_start - INTERVAL 12 MONTH)::DATE AS trailing_12_start
    FROM bounds
)

        , product_master AS (
            SELECT
                PRODUCT_ID,
                min(FAMILY) AS FAMILY,
                min(SERVICE) AS SERVICE
            FROM mlai_products
            WHERE COMPID = 1
            GROUP BY PRODUCT_ID
        ),
        scoped_sales AS (
            SELECT sales.*
            FROM aviv_bo_cs_cash_sales AS sales
            CROSS JOIN periods
            WHERE sales.SA_COMPID = 1
              AND sales.SA_DATE >= periods.trailing_12_start
              AND sales.SA_DATE < periods.latest_closed_end
        )
        SELECT
            CASE
                WHEN product_master.PRODUCT_ID IS NULL THEN 'unmatched_product'
                WHEN product_master.FAMILY IN ('200', '800') THEN 'insoles'
                WHEN product_master.FAMILY = '100' THEN 'footwear'
                WHEN product_master.FAMILY = '750' THEN 'pain_treatment'
                WHEN product_master.FAMILY = '300' THEN 'accessory'
                WHEN product_master.FAMILY = '998' THEN 'family_998_unreviewed'
                WHEN product_master.FAMILY IS NULL THEN 'missing_family'
                ELSE 'other_family'
            END AS analytical_category,
            coalesce(nullif(trim(product_master.SERVICE), ''), '(blank_or_null)') AS service_flag,
            count(*) AS sales_lines,
            count(DISTINCT scoped_sales.SA_PRODUCT_ID) AS distinct_product_ids,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE scoped_sales.SA_TOTAL < 0) AS negative_total_lines,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE scoped_sales.SA_TOTAL = 0) AS zero_total_lines
        FROM scoped_sales
        LEFT JOIN product_master
          ON product_master.PRODUCT_ID = scoped_sales.SA_PRODUCT_ID
        GROUP BY analytical_category, service_flag
        ORDER BY analytical_category, service_flag

WITH bounds AS (
    SELECT
        max(SA_DATE)::DATE AS data_max_date,
        date_trunc('month', max(SA_DATE))::DATE AS open_month_start
    FROM aviv_bo_cs_cash_sales
    WHERE SA_COMPID = 1
),
periods AS (
    SELECT
        data_max_date,
        open_month_start,
        (open_month_start - INTERVAL 1 MONTH)::DATE AS latest_closed_start,
        open_month_start AS latest_closed_end,
        (open_month_start - INTERVAL 12 MONTH)::DATE AS trailing_12_start
    FROM bounds
)

        , order_numbers AS (
            SELECT
                ORDER_NO,
                count(*) AS header_rows,
                count(DISTINCT ORDER_KEY) AS order_keys
            FROM mlai_order_header
            WHERE COMPID = 1
            GROUP BY ORDER_NO
        ),
        scoped_sales AS (
            SELECT sales.*
            FROM aviv_bo_cs_cash_sales AS sales
            CROSS JOIN periods
            WHERE sales.SA_COMPID = 1
              AND sales.SA_DATE >= periods.trailing_12_start
              AND sales.SA_DATE < periods.latest_closed_end
        )
        SELECT
            (SELECT count(*) FROM order_numbers) AS distinct_order_numbers,
            (SELECT count(*) FROM order_numbers WHERE header_rows > 1) AS duplicate_order_number_groups,
            (SELECT max(header_rows) FROM order_numbers) AS maximum_headers_per_order_number,
            count(*) AS sales_lines,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE SA_ORDER_NO IS NOT NULL AND SA_ORDER_NO <> 0) AS sales_lines_with_order_number,
            count(*) FILTER (
                WHERE SA_ORDER_NO IS NOT NULL
                  AND SA_ORDER_NO <> 0
                  AND EXISTS (
                      SELECT 1
                      FROM order_numbers
                      WHERE order_numbers.ORDER_NO = scoped_sales.SA_ORDER_NO
                  )
            ) AS sales_lines_with_any_header_match,
            count(*) FILTER (
                WHERE SA_ORDER_NO IS NOT NULL
                  AND SA_ORDER_NO <> 0
                  AND EXISTS (
                      SELECT 1
                      FROM order_numbers
                      WHERE order_numbers.ORDER_NO = scoped_sales.SA_ORDER_NO
                        AND order_numbers.header_rows = 1
                  )
            ) AS sales_lines_with_unique_header_match,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE SA_ORDER_LINE_NO IS NOT NULL AND SA_ORDER_LINE_NO <> 0) AS sales_lines_with_order_line_number,
            count(*) FILTER (
                WHERE SA_ORDER_NO IS NOT NULL
                  AND SA_ORDER_NO <> 0
                  AND SA_ORDER_LINE_NO IS NOT NULL
                  AND EXISTS (
                      SELECT 1
                      FROM mlai_order_header AS header
                      JOIN mlai_order_lines AS line
                        ON line.COMPID = header.COMPID
                       AND line.ORDER_KEY = header.ORDER_KEY
                      WHERE header.COMPID = 1
                        AND header.ORDER_NO = scoped_sales.SA_ORDER_NO
                        AND line.ROW_NO = scoped_sales.SA_ORDER_LINE_NO
                  )
            ) AS sales_lines_with_exact_order_line_match,
            count(*) FILTER (
                WHERE SA_ORDER_NO IS NOT NULL
                  AND SA_ORDER_NO <> 0
                  AND SA_ORDER_LINE_NO IS NOT NULL
                  AND EXISTS (
                      SELECT 1
                      FROM mlai_order_header AS header
                      JOIN mlai_order_lines AS line
                        ON line.COMPID = header.COMPID
                       AND line.ORDER_KEY = header.ORDER_KEY
                      WHERE header.COMPID = 1
                        AND header.ORDER_NO = scoped_sales.SA_ORDER_NO
                        AND line.ROW_NO = scoped_sales.SA_ORDER_LINE_NO
                        AND line.PRODUCT_ID = scoped_sales.SA_PRODUCT_ID
                  )
            ) AS sales_lines_with_exact_product_line_match
        FROM scoped_sales

WITH bounds AS (
    SELECT
        max(SA_DATE)::DATE AS data_max_date,
        date_trunc('month', max(SA_DATE))::DATE AS open_month_start
    FROM aviv_bo_cs_cash_sales
    WHERE SA_COMPID = 1
),
periods AS (
    SELECT
        data_max_date,
        open_month_start,
        (open_month_start - INTERVAL 1 MONTH)::DATE AS latest_closed_start,
        open_month_start AS latest_closed_end,
        (open_month_start - INTERVAL 12 MONTH)::DATE AS trailing_12_start
    FROM bounds
)

        , product_master AS (
            SELECT PRODUCT_ID, min(FAMILY) AS FAMILY
            FROM mlai_products
            WHERE COMPID = 1
            GROUP BY PRODUCT_ID
        ),
        scoped_headers AS (
            SELECT header.ORDER_KEY
            FROM mlai_order_header AS header
            CROSS JOIN periods
            WHERE header.COMPID = 1
              AND header.ORDER_OPEN_DATE >= periods.trailing_12_start
              AND header.ORDER_OPEN_DATE < periods.latest_closed_end
        ),
        scoped_order_lines AS (
            SELECT lines.*
            FROM scoped_headers
            JOIN mlai_order_lines AS lines
              ON lines.COMPID = 1
             AND lines.ORDER_KEY = scoped_headers.ORDER_KEY
        )
        SELECT
            count(*) AS order_lines,

            count(DISTINCT scoped_order_lines.PRODUCT_ID) AS distinct_product_ids,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE product_master.PRODUCT_ID IS NOT NULL) AS product_master_matched_lines,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE scoped_order_lines.COSTING_PRICE IS NOT NULL) AS costing_price_populated_lines,

            count(*) FILTER (WHERE scoped_order_lines.MANUFACTURE_PRICE IS NOT NULL) AS manufacture_price_populated_lines,

            count(*) FILTER (WHERE scoped_order_lines.QTY_RETURNED IS NOT NULL AND scoped_order_lines.QTY_RETURNED <> 0) AS returned_quantity_lines,

WITH bounds AS (
    SELECT
        max(SA_DATE)::DATE AS data_max_date,
        date_trunc('month', max(SA_DATE))::DATE AS open_month_start
    FROM aviv_bo_cs_cash_sales
    WHERE SA_COMPID = 1
),
periods AS (
    SELECT
        data_max_date,
        open_month_start,
        (open_month_start - INTERVAL 1 MONTH)::DATE AS latest_closed_start,
        open_month_start AS latest_closed_end,
        (open_month_start - INTERVAL 12 MONTH)::DATE AS trailing_12_start
    FROM bounds
)

        , scoped_sales AS (
            SELECT sales.*
            FROM aviv_bo_cs_cash_sales AS sales
            CROSS JOIN periods
            WHERE sales.SA_COMPID = 1
              AND sales.SA_DATE >= periods.trailing_12_start
              AND sales.SA_DATE < periods.latest_closed_end
              AND sales.SA_TOTAL IS NOT NULL
              AND sales.SA_QTY IS NOT NULL
              AND sales.SA_PRICE IS NOT NULL
        )
        SELECT
            count(*) AS comparable_lines,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE abs(SA_TOTAL - SA_QTY * SA_PRICE) <= 0.05) AS total_equals_quantity_times_price,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE abs(SA_TOTAL - SA_QTY * (SA_PRICE - coalesce(SA_DISCOUNT, 0))) <= 0.05) AS total_equals_quantity_times_price_less_discount,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE abs(SA_TOTAL - (SA_QTY * SA_PRICE - coalesce(SA_DISCOUNT, 0))) <= 0.05) AS total_equals_extended_price_less_discount,
            count(*) FILTER (
                WHERE SA_PRC_DISCOUNT IS NOT NULL
                  AND abs(SA_TOTAL - SA_QTY * SA_PRICE * (1 - SA_PRC_DISCOUNT / 100.0)) <= 0.05
            ) AS total_equals_percent_discount_candidate,
            count(*) FILTER (
                WHERE SA_VAT_SUM IS NOT NULL
                  AND SA_VAT_RATE IS NOT NULL
                  AND abs(SA_VAT_SUM - SA_TOTAL * SA_VAT_RATE / (100 + SA_VAT_RATE)) <= 0.05
            ) AS vat_matches_vat_inclusive_total,
            count(*) FILTER (
                WHERE SA_VAT_SUM IS NOT NULL
                  AND SA_VAT_RATE IS NOT NULL
                  AND abs(SA_VAT_SUM - SA_TOTAL * SA_VAT_RATE / 100.0) <= 0.05
            ) AS vat_matches_vat_exclusive_total
        FROM scoped_sales

WITH bounds AS (

),
periods AS (

)

        , mlai_product_master AS (
            SELECT PRODUCT_ID, min(COST_PRICE) AS COST_PRICE
            FROM mlai_products
            WHERE COMPID = 1
            GROUP BY PRODUCT_ID
        ),
        pos_product_master AS (
            SELECT WIN_PRODUCT_ID AS PRODUCT_ID, min(WIN_COST_PRICE) AS COST_PRICE
            FROM aviv_bo_cs_products
            WHERE WIN_COMPID = 1
            GROUP BY WIN_PRODUCT_ID
        ),
        scoped_sales AS (
            SELECT sales.*
            FROM aviv_bo_cs_cash_sales AS sales
            CROSS JOIN periods
            WHERE sales.SA_COMPID = 1
              AND sales.SA_DATE >= periods.trailing_12_start
              AND sales.SA_DATE < periods.latest_closed_end
              AND sales.SA_COST_PRICE IS NOT NULL
              AND sales.SA_QTY IS NOT NULL
        )
        SELECT
            CASE
                WHEN abs(scoped_sales.SA_QTY) = 1 THEN 'absolute_quantity_1'
                WHEN abs(scoped_sales.SA_QTY) > 1 THEN 'absolute_quantity_gt_1'
                ELSE 'zero_or_fractional_quantity'
            END AS quantity_group,
            count(*) AS sales_lines,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE mlai_product_master.PRODUCT_ID IS NOT NULL) AS mlai_master_matches,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE pos_product_master.PRODUCT_ID IS NOT NULL) AS pos_master_matches,
            count(*) FILTER (
                WHERE mlai_product_master.COST_PRICE IS NOT NULL
                  AND abs(scoped_sales.SA_COST_PRICE - mlai_product_master.COST_PRICE) <= 0.05
            ) AS line_cost_matches_mlai_unit_cost,
            count(*) FILTER (
                WHERE mlai_product_master.COST_PRICE IS NOT NULL
                  AND abs(scoped_sales.SA_COST_PRICE / nullif(abs(scoped_sales.SA_QTY), 0) - mlai_product_master.COST_PRICE) <= 0.05
            ) AS line_cost_divided_by_quantity_matches_mlai_cost,
            count(*) FILTER (
                WHERE pos_product_master.COST_PRICE IS NOT NULL
                  AND abs(scoped_sales.SA_COST_PRICE - pos_product_master.COST_PRICE) <= 0.05
            ) AS line_cost_matches_pos_unit_cost,
            count(*) FILTER (
                WHERE pos_product_master.COST_PRICE IS NOT NULL
                  AND abs(scoped_sales.SA_COST_PRICE / nullif(abs(scoped_sales.SA_QTY), 0) - pos_product_master.COST_PRICE) <= 0.05
            ) AS line_cost_divided_by_quantity_matches_pos_cost
        FROM scoped_sales
        LEFT JOIN mlai_product_master
          ON mlai_product_master.PRODUCT_ID = scoped_sales.SA_PRODUCT_ID
        LEFT JOIN pos_product_master
          ON pos_product_master.PRODUCT_ID = scoped_sales.SA_PRODUCT_ID
        GROUP BY quantity_group
        ORDER BY quantity_group

WITH candidates AS (
            SELECT lower(owner || '_' || table_name) AS table_name, n_rows
            FROM _manifest
